metadata.title: Oracle’s stock is totally misunderstood and should be a ‘go-to’ AI play, says this analyst - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Oracle’s stock is totally misunderstood and should be a ‘go-to’ AI play, says this analyst
A Bernstein analyst thinks two key investor concerns will soon subside
Oracle could be closer than investors realize to generating serious returns on its artificial-intelligence investments. And according to one analyst, there are big catalysts on the horizon.
Shares of Oracle ORCL are down 36% so far this year, with the company seemingly at the center of several AI “controversies,” according to Bernstein analyst Mark Moerdler. Those include whether the AI buildout is a bubble, whether data centers can support strong economics and whether the company’s big AI customers can succeed in their own right.
